about: Inputs the contract vectors do not cover (ECMAScript and Python regex semantics, lengths in code points, the if/then rules, odd keys and member types, dates, credential shapes, URLs WHATWG refuses or serializes, IDN hosts, file drive letters, query names with a leading `?`, lone surrogates), from the three blind readings of 0.44.0. make_connections_vectors.mjs answers each with the contract's connectionsView into contract/connections-extra-vectors.json. Kept only where the Node twin answers alike on Node 18, 20, 22, 24 and 26 (the reference reads URLs with the runtime's own `new URL`, whose IDNA handling changes between releases) and where the Python twin answers as the reference (the rest is the closed side, decision D5, row FAA-98). Never edited by hand except to add inputs.
